description: Központi Statisztikai Hivatal: drainage datasets is a collection of datasets listed in National Public Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Központi Statisztikai Hivatal. Coverage: Központi Statisztikai Hivatal. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drainage; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Belvízi áruszállítás a hajó felségjele szerint [ezer átkm]; Belvízi áruszállítás a hajó felségjele szerint, negyedévenként; Szervetlen ionok csapadékvízben mért koncentrációja a háttérállomásoko. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-kozadatportal.
